gate_changes_reviewed: Funnel v2.1 current-object claim ceilings now live across the material pool
fresh SYSTEM-to-MECHANISM successor pattern demonstrated without same-object upgrade
rolling theory-backward mechanism supply produced a genuine falsifiable MECHANISM Discovery
orthogonal HOLD/terminal/queue fields and classification completeness now persisted
READY semantics explicitly remain development readiness, not prior scientific success
false_positive_risks: Future quota pressure could relabel weak SYSTEM/API questions as MECHANISM; current Assembly case did not.
Future SYSTEM priority exceptions could be rationalized post hoc unless written prospectively; no current exception is in use.
Small-N funnel conversion rates could be overread despite 7/7 completeness; current Evidence explicitly avoids this.
false_negative_risks: MECHANISM priority could suppress integrity-critical SYSTEM work if exception semantics are ignored; current policy preserves the exception.
A future READY checklist could become a hidden second Formal gate if READY is interpreted as prior comparator/reduction/falsifier success; current semantics do not do this.
The theory-backward quota could manufacture low-quality mechanism candidates; first live case was coherent and negative, so this risk is not currently realized.

moving_goalpost_assessment.finding: Funnel v2.1 is prospective; completed/consumed objects are not backfilled, rescored, relabeled, rerun, invalidated, or upgraded.

pass_reachability_assessment.finding: No hidden success predicate is currently inserted before PRE_FORMAL, but the first live READY-to-PRE_FORMAL transition has not yet occurred.

claim_type_separation_findings: Healthy. The Assembly SYSTEM lifecycle object retained architecture/resource value while a fresh Assembly-feedback MECHANISM object was independently tested and rejected; neither was used to launder the other claim type.

mechanism_supply_health.finding: The qualifying MECHANISM selection was theory-backward, prospectively falsifiable, and accepted a negative result without rescue.

funnel_observability.finding: All material current candidates have mandatory v2.1 fields; rates are scoped to the complete classified population and are not policy thresholds.

preformal_gate_calibration.finding: READY means the next PRE_FORMAL test is well-defined and informative, not that the candidate has already succeeded scientifically.

system_priority_exception_audit.finding: No comparable executable/informative MECHANISM candidate was bypassed. Previous Assembly SYSTEM allocation predates v2.1 and was not retroactively justified.

no_coherent_target_audit.finding: No escape-hatch behavior observed; current rolling window met the mechanism-supply rule with a real MECHANISM object.

classification_completeness.policy_use: Conversion rates may be described for this population but must not be treated as universal thresholds.

prospective_recommendations: Keep v2.1 current-object ceilings and fresh-successor semantics.
Keep the one-in-three rule but judge it by coherent/falsifiable mechanism supply, not positive results.
Keep MAIN idle when no central MECHANISM or integrity-protecting high-value SYSTEM object exists.
Persist SYSTEM priority exceptions prospectively whenever a comparable MECHANISM object actually exists.
Audit the first real READY-to-PRE_FORMAL transition; do not make READY a pre-success gate.
Do not add a universal numeric support/readiness threshold from small-N funnel metrics.
questions_for_control_evidence_analyst: When first eligibility=true occurs, will a legitimate eligibility=true/readiness=NOT_READY state be durably representable?
When first SYSTEM-over-comparable-MECHANISM allocation occurs, will system_priority_exception be written before execution?
When first NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET exception is used, will the quality-floor failure be recorded without a filler candidate?
